values.prompt:
Create one polished 16:9 Location Sheet for the Constantinople sea walls: a single finished production reference board for siege shot planning, not a poster.

## Primary view
Make the largest panel a siege-facing establishing view from the Ottoman field toward the wall massing.

## Supporting studies
Include a reverse field-to-wall angle; a high-angle wall, field, and city layout; gate and breach landmarks; weathered stone and repaired masonry swatches; human and siege-equipment scale; smoke and golden-hour lighting; earthworks, ladders, cannon gear, tents, and debris.

## Continuity
Keep every panel consistent with the same 1453 location, materials, palette, field direction, city-edge depth, and Production Lookbook texture and lighting behavior. Keep labels small and outside important visual content.

## Exclusions
No modern roads, electrical wires, signage, vehicles, glass curtain walls, industrial streetlights, debug overlays, crop marks, UI, or decorative poster typography.
